introduction: Hi! My name is Henrique, I'm 27 years old, and welcome to my portfolio. Here you'll find my projects — in progress, already delivered, or planned — along with my certifications and the tech stacks I work with. Please use the command terminal below to get started. It's simple: just type the command you want to access. If needed, press the up arrow to recall previously executed commands, or type 'help' if you get stuck.
aboutMeText: I come from a background in International Relations, but I found in software development the path that truly makes sense to me. I'm currently studying Systems Analysis and Development at FIAP while working as an N1 Support Analyst at Bullla. Day to day, that means investigating recurring issues, turning support tickets into useful data for the dev teams, and automating whatever I can to prevent tickets in the first place. I already have a solid grasp of PL/SQL and I'm deepening my knowledge of Java and C, always with the same goal: becoming a back-end developer. In my free time, I enjoy consuming content related to sci-fi, video games, music, and sports in general.
